```{r setup}
pacman::p_load(
  "dplyr", "tidyr", "purrr", "here",
  "psych",        # alpha(), omega(), describe()
  "knitr", "kableExtra"
)

options(knitr.table.format = "html", scipen = 999)

proj_path <- here()
quest_path <- file.path(proj_path, "data", "SOS_questionnaire_data.csv")
```

```{r load-data}
quest_raw <- read.csv(quest_path) |>
  rename(SampleID = SID) |>
  mutate(across(-SampleID, \(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))))

cat("N participants:", nrow(quest_raw), "\n")
```

---

# CES-DC

**Center for Epidemiological Studies Depression Scale for Children** (Weissman et al., 1980).
20 items, 0–3 scale. Items 4, 8, 12, 16 are positively worded and reverse-scored (3 – item).
Total range 0–60; clinical cutoff ≥ 15.

```{r cesdc-score}
cesdc_items <- quest_raw |>
  select(SampleID, starts_with("CES_DC_")) |>
  mutate(
    CES_DC_4  = 3 - CES_DC_4,
    CES_DC_8  = 3 - CES_DC_8,
    CES_DC_12 = 3 - CES_DC_12,
    CES_DC_16 = 3 - CES_DC_16
  )

cesdc_mat <- cesdc_items |> select(-SampleID) |> as.matrix()

cesdc_scores <- cesdc_items |>
  mutate(CESDC_total = rowSums(cesdc_mat, na.rm = FALSE)) |>
  select(SampleID, CESDC_total)
```

## Item descriptives

```{r cesdc-item-desc}
describe(cesdc_mat) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(n, mean, sd, min, max, skew, kurtosis) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  kable(caption = "CES-DC item descriptives (after reverse-scoring)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

## Internal consistency

```{r cesdc-alpha}
cesdc_alpha <- alpha(cesdc_mat, check.keys = FALSE)
print(cesdc_alpha, digits = 3)
```

```{r cesdc-alpha-tbl}
tibble(
  Statistic = c("α (raw)", "α (std.)", "95% CI lower", "95% CI upper",
                "Mean inter-item r", "Median inter-item r"),
  Value = c(
    round(cesdc_alpha$total$raw_alpha,  3),
    round(cesdc_alpha$total$std.alpha,  3),
    round(cesdc_alpha$feldt$lower.ci$raw_alpha, 3),
    round(cesdc_alpha$feldt$upper.ci$raw_alpha, 3),
    round(cesdc_alpha$total$average_r,   3),
    round(cesdc_alpha$total$median_r,    3)
  )
) |>
  kable(caption = "CES-DC internal consistency") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

## Item-total correlations

```{r cesdc-item-total}
cesdc_alpha$item.stats |>
  select(r.cor, r.drop) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  rename(`r (corrected item-total)` = r.cor,
         `r (α if item dropped)`   = r.drop) |>
  kable(caption = "CES-DC item-total correlations") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

## Total score descriptives

```{r cesdc-total-desc}
describe(cesdc_scores$CESDC_total) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(n, mean, sd, min, max, skew, kurtosis) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  kable(caption = "CES-DC total score (0–60; cutoff ≥ 15)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)

cat("N above cutoff (≥ 15):",
    sum(cesdc_scores$CESDC_total >= 15, na.rm = TRUE),
    sprintf("(%.1f%%)", 100 * mean(cesdc_scores$CESDC_total >= 15, na.rm = TRUE)), "\n")
```

# Puberty

## Pubertal Development Scale (PDS)

**Petersen et al. (1988), female version.** Items F1–F5 rated 1–4 (1 = no development,
4 = development seems complete). Item F6 = menarche (0 = no, 1 = yes). Items F7–F10
capture menarche timing (free-text / age fields) and are excluded from the scale score.

PDS total score = mean of F1–F5; menarche status reported separately.

```{r pds-score}
pds_items <- quest_raw |>
  select(SampleID, PDS_F1, PDS_F2, PDS_F3, PDS_F4, PDS_F5, PDS_F6)

pds_mat <- pds_items |> select(PDS_F1:PDS_F5) |> as.matrix()

pds_scores <- pds_items |>
  mutate(
    PDS_mean     = rowMeans(pds_mat, na.rm = FALSE),
    PDS_menarche = PDS_F6
  ) |>
  select(SampleID, PDS_mean, PDS_menarche)
```

### Item descriptives (F1–F5)

```{r pds-item-desc}
describe(pds_mat) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(n, mean, sd, min, max, skew, kurtosis) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  kable(caption = "PDS items F1–F5 descriptives (1 = no development, 4 = complete)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)

cat("Menarche: yes =", sum(pds_items$PDS_F6 == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    ", no =", sum(pds_items$PDS_F6 == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

### Internal consistency (F1–F5)

```{r pds-alpha}
pds_alpha <- alpha(pds_mat, check.keys = TRUE)
print(pds_alpha, digits = 3)
```

```{r pds-alpha-tbl}
tibble(
  Statistic = c("α (raw)", "α (std.)", "95% CI lower", "95% CI upper",
                "Mean inter-item r"),
  Value = c(
    round(pds_alpha$total$raw_alpha,   3),
    round(pds_alpha$total$std.alpha,   3),
    round(pds_alpha$feldt$lower.ci$raw_alpha, 3),
    round(pds_alpha$feldt$upper.ci$raw_alpha, 3),
    round(pds_alpha$total$average_r,   3)
  )
) |>
  kable(caption = "PDS internal consistency (items F1–F5)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

### Item-total correlations (F1–F5)

```{r pds-item-total}
pds_alpha$item.stats |>
  select(r.cor, r.drop) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  rename(`r (corrected item-total)` = r.cor,
         `r (α if item dropped)`   = r.drop) |>
  kable(caption = "PDS item-total correlations") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

### Total score descriptives

```{r pds-total-desc}
describe(pds_scores$PDS_mean) |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(n, mean, sd, min, max, skew, kurtosis) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  kable(caption = "PDS mean score (F1–F5; range 1–4)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

## Pubertal Body Image (PBIP)

**Pubertal Body Image Perception** (PBIP; Koff & Rierdan, 1995). 4 items (1A, 1B, 2A, 2B),
rated 2–5. Higher scores indicate more advanced perceived pubertal development.

```{r pbip-score}
pbip_items <- quest_raw |>
  select(SampleID, PBIP_1A, PBIP_1B, PBIP_2A, PBIP_2B)

pbip_mat <- pbip_items |> select(-SampleID) |> as.matrix()

pbip_scores <- pbip_items |>
  mutate(PBIP_mean = rowMeans(pbip_mat, na.rm = FALSE)) |>
  select(SampleID, PBIP_mean)
```

```{r pbip-item-desc}
describe(pbip_mat) |>

  kable(caption = "PBIP item descriptives (2–5)") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

```{r pbip-alpha}
print(pbip_alpha, digits = 3)
```

```{r pbip-alpha-tbl}
) |>
```

# BFNES

**Brief Fear of Negative Evaluation Scale** (Leary, 1983). 12 items, 1–5 scale.
Items 2, 6, 7, 10 are reverse-scored (6 – item). Sum total range 12–60;
higher scores indicate greater fear of negative evaluation.

```{r bfnes-score}
bfnes_items <- quest_raw |>
  select(SampleID, starts_with("BFNES_")) |>
  mutate(
    BFNES_2  = 6 - BFNES_2,
    BFNES_6  = 6 - BFNES_6,
    BFNES_7  = 6 - BFNES_7,
    BFNES_10 = 6 - BFNES_10
  )

bfnes_mat <- bfnes_items |> select(-SampleID) |> as.matrix()

bfnes_scores <- bfnes_items |>
  mutate(BFNES_total = rowSums(bfnes_mat, na.rm = FALSE)) |>
  select(SampleID, BFNES_total)
```

```{r bfnes-item-desc}
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```

# Scored totals summary

```{r all-totals}
list(cesdc_scores, pds_scores, pbip_scores, bfnes_scores) |>
  reduce(full_join, by = "SampleID") |>
  select(-SampleID) |>
  describe() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  select(n, mean, sd, min, max, skew, kurtosis) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 2))) |>
  kable(caption = "All scale totals — descriptive summary") |>
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "hover", full_width = FALSE)
```
